Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any worn item or minion whose mod uses Hikari's fur textures, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it. The mods aren't included.
Punchline: Real strand fur on items that use Hikari's fur textures.
Changelog: New "Other players" setting (off by default): fur on the other characters around you and on actors posed in GPose, in their own colours. Other players' mods only show on your screen through a sync plugin (Lightless, Mare, Snowcloak), so their fur shows wherever their Hikari items do. Each extra fur coat costs GPU time and about 230 MB of GPU memory. Hair, tails and anything else resting on a fur item now lie on top of the fur instead of showing through it as dark streaks (new setting "Hair lies on the fur", on by default). Model files renamed by sync plugins now get the race fit too.
